clue.text: Is, within very short time, providing make-up for face

indicators.note: within says the first word sits inside the letters that follow it

parts.note: V is the short form of very
an age is a period of time
taken as written

explanation.surface: A make-up artist works quickly to make someone's face presentable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Very short' is very abbreviated to V, not a description of the time; IS goes between V and AGE.
explanation.definitionFit: Visage is a literary word for the human face or countenance.

clue.text: Brief evocative piece in novel given title, oddly

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters are made into a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: oddly means taking only the letters in odd-numbered positions of the word beside it

parts.note: first, third and fifth letters of title

explanation.surface: A short, atmospheric scene in a novel is given a heading, rather strangely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Novel' reads as the book holding the piece but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A vignette is a short descriptive sketch that captures a mood or moment.

clue.text: Small furry mammal seen in spruce

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small
a marten is a furry weasel-like animal

explanation.surface: A little furry creature is spotted in a spruce tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spruce' looks like the conifer, but it is the verb meaning tidy up.
explanation.definitionFit: To spruce up and to smarten are both verbs for making neat and tidy.

clue.text: Weed land encircling house on European lake

parts.note: the grounds are the land around a house
E is the abbreviation for European
L is the abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A weed has taken hold of the ground round a house beside a lake on the Continent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Encircling' looks like a container signal, but the whole phrase defines one word; 'on' then adds the other two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Groundsel is a common yellow-flowered weed of gardens and waste ground.

clue.text: Delivering article after wife returned

indicators.note: something returned goes back the way it came, so the word for wife is read right to left

parts.note: a rib, from Eve being made of Adam's rib, is a jocular word for a wife
an article is an object or thing

explanation.surface: A man brings home an item after his wife has come back from a trip.
explanation.walkthrough: Calling a wife a rib is an old joke from Genesis, where Eve is made from Adam's rib.
explanation.definitionFit: Birthing is the act of bringing a baby into the world, which a midwife calls delivering.

clue.text: Illicit dealing that's never seen in open-air market?

definitions.text: Illicit dealing that's never seen in open-air market?

parts.note: the plain sense: crooked financial dealing using secret information
the playful sense: business conducted indoors can never happen at an outdoor market

explanation.walkthrough: The joke reads the name of a financial crime literally, as commerce done indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: Insider trading is the illegal buying or selling of shares using confidential company knowledge.

clue.text: Subject to minimal change in charge

parts.note: taken as written
P, a penny, is the smallest unit of British coinage
IC is the standard abbreviation for in charge

explanation.surface: Someone is liable to a slight alteration in what they must pay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Subject to' reads as one phrase, but the definition stops at 'Subject'. A penny (P) is the smallest British coin, the least change you can get.
explanation.definitionFit: A topic is the subject or theme under discussion.

clue.text: Occupying position overlooking church, fire

parts.note: occupying a place is being in it
the spire is the tall pointed structure rising above a church

explanation.surface: A blaze breaks out in a building that looks down on a church.
explanation.definitionFit: To fire someone up, or fire their imagination, is to inspire them with enthusiasm.

clue.text: Good and wet? It's not clear

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for good
rainy weather is wet

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether damp weather is a good thing and gets no clear answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A grainy photograph or picture is coarse and fuzzy, lacking sharp definition.

clue.text: Get position of captain for game

parts.note: to contract an illness is to get it
a ship's captain commands from the bridge

explanation.surface: Someone lands the job of team captain in a sport.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Captain' suggests a sports team, but it is a ship's master on the bridge.
explanation.definitionFit: Contract bridge is the standard form of the card game played by two partnerships.

clue.text: Heartless girl, passionate and beautiful

indicators.note: a heartless word has had its middle removed, leaving just its outside letters

parts.note: the word girl without its middle letters
amorous means full of passionate love

explanation.surface: A cold-hearted girl who is nonetheless passionate and lovely, a femme fatale.
explanation.definitionFit: Glamorous describes someone strikingly attractive and alluring, close to beautiful.

clue.text: Two pieces of tapas exchanged for Italian food

indicators.note: the word is split into two chunks that then swap places, a rearrangement of its letters
exchanged says those chunks trade positions, changing the letter order

parts.note: taken as written; split as TA and PAS

explanation.surface: A restaurant swaps a couple of the Spanish small plates for an Italian dish.
explanation.walkthrough: TA-PAS becomes PAS-TA when its two halves change places.
explanation.definitionFit: Pasta is the staple Italian food made from durum wheat dough, such as spaghetti.

clue.text: Put out text initially rejected in court

indicators.note: rejecting something initially means dropping its first letter

parts.note: text without its opening letter
taken as written
CT is a standard abbreviation for court

explanation.surface: A text message is refused as evidence in a courtroom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In court' looks like a location, but IN and CT both supply letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A fire or light that has been put out is extinguished, and extinct is used of a volcano or flame no longer burning.

clue.text: Moved to CID, in manner of speaking

indicators.note: letters that are moved are shifted around into a new order

parts.note: the letters of these three words

explanation.surface: A police officer transferred to the CID changes the way they talk.
explanation.walkthrough: CID is Britain's Criminal Investigation Department, the plain-clothes detective branch.
explanation.definitionFit: Diction is the style of enunciation in speech, a person's way of pronouncing words.

clue.text: Isn't mistaken about capital of Uganda, or other African capital

indicators.note: about means going round, so the jumbled letters surround the selected one
a mistaken word has its letters set down wrongly, out of order

parts.note: the letters of the word, apostrophe ignored

indicators.note: the capital of a word is its first, upper-case letter

parts.note: first letter of Uganda

explanation.surface: Someone insists they are right about which city is Uganda's capital, or another African one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' is used twice: once for an initial letter, once for a seat of government.
explanation.definitionFit: Tunis is the capital city of Tunisia, in North Africa.

clue.text: Cut link between eastern parts of Russia and Poland

indicators.note: in an across entry east is the right-hand end, so the eastern parts are the final letters

parts.note: last letter of Russia
a bridge links two places
last letter of Poland

explanation.surface: Someone severs a connection between the far-eastern regions of Russia and Poland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Between' puts BRIDGE between the two end letters, A and D.
explanation.definitionFit: An abridged book or text has been shortened, with material cut from it.

clue.text: Heroic actions going wrong in unconventional rising

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed inside the other
in a down entry rising means read from bottom to top, so the word is turned backwards

parts.note: odd means unusual or unconventional
erring means making a mistake

explanation.surface: Brave deeds go awry during an unorthodox rebellion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rising' looks like an uprising, but it turns the word for unconventional upside down.
explanation.definitionFit: Derring-do is daring, heroic action of the swashbuckling kind.

clue.text: Advance publicity covering monstrous female

indicators.note: in a down entry one piece covering another sits above it, so it comes first

parts.note: PR is public relations, publicity
an ogress is a female ogre

explanation.surface: Early press coverage of a fearsome woman.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer, 'covering' means sitting on top, so the publicity comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: Progress and advance are both verbs and nouns for moving forward.

clue.text: Electoral analyst inserting lines in notice

indicators.note: inserting means putting something into the middle of something else

parts.note: a poster is a public notice
L is the abbreviation for line, doubled for the plural

explanation.surface: A political analyst adds extra lines to a published notice.
explanation.definitionFit: A pollster conducts opinion polls, analysing how people intend to vote in elections.

clue.text: Agitated as Roman chap having a row

indicators.note: something agitated is stirred up and shaken about, mixing the letters

parts.note: the letters of these two words

explanation.surface: An upset Roman man is caught up in a quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' rhymes with cow, a quarrel, in the surface, but rhymes with go in the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An oarsman is a man who rows a boat, propelling it with oars.

clue.text: Competitor on track runs after people

parts.note: a race is a people or ethnic group
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A sprinter on the track chases down other runners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' puts R after RACE.
explanation.definitionFit: A racer is anyone, human, horse or car, who competes in races on a circuit.

clue.text: Smart move, going around a city in US

indicators.note: going around means encircling, so the preceding words wrap the next one

parts.note: chic means stylish and smart
taken as written
a go is a turn or move in a game

explanation.surface: A clever move takes a traveller on a round trip of an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: Chicago is a major city in the US state of Illinois.

clue.text: Partly declaim, partly communicate

indicators.note: partly says only a part of the following letters is used

parts.note: found running across the end of the first word and the start of the second

explanation.surface: A speaker half declaims and half talks.
explanation.walkthrough: The second 'partly' is both part of the hiding place and a decoy for the definition's structure.
explanation.definitionFit: To impart information is to communicate or pass it on.

clue.text: Male with sign who takes part in moving protest?

definitions.text: who takes part in moving protest?

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for male
the Archer is Sagittarius, a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: A man carrying a placard joins a protest procession.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sign' suggests a protester's placard, but it is a star sign.
explanation.definitionFit: A marcher walks in a demonstration, a protest that moves along the streets; the question mark flags the playful phrasing.

clue.text: Reduce risk of loss in hospital — proceed with caution

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs
to edge forward is to move slowly and carefully

explanation.surface: Advice to tread carefully to avoid harm while in hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: To hedge a bet is to protect against losing money by backing more than one outcome.

clue.text: Operating aquatic sport around river

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so one word wraps the abbreviation

parts.note: diving is a sport performed in water
R is the abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: Someone runs a water-sports business on a riverbank.
explanation.definitionFit: Driving a vehicle or machine means operating and controlling it.

clue.text: Prepared to be belligerent in popular media

indicators.note: in says the letters sit inside the run of words that follows

parts.note: found inside the run of letters across these two words

explanation.surface: The popular press stands ready to pick a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: Being armed means carrying weapons, equipped and ready for hostile action.

clue.text: Run down gradient in disarray, heading east

indicators.note: a thing in disarray is out of order, so its letters need rearranging

parts.note: taken as written
E is the compass abbreviation for east, heading here meaning travelling towards

explanation.surface: A runner careers down a messy slope heading towards the east.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Run down' looks like a jogger on a slope but means to criticise.
explanation.definitionFit: To run down someone is to disparage or belittle them, which is what denigrate means.

clue.text: Offered caretaker abbreviated education

indicators.note: an abbreviated word is cut short, leaving only part of it

parts.note: a tender is someone who tends or looks after something
ED is the usual short form of education

explanation.surface: A school caretaker was given only a brief education.
explanation.definitionFit: To tender something, such as a resignation or payment, is to formally offer it.

clue.text: Pour so badly, unable to retain liquid

indicators.note: doing something badly means doing it wrongly, so the letters come out in the wrong order

parts.note: the letters of these two words

explanation.surface: Someone pours so clumsily that the drink keeps spilling.
explanation.definitionFit: A porous material is full of tiny holes, so water seeps through it instead of being held.
